company.name: Space Magnum Equipments Pvt. Ltd.
company.about: Space Magnum began in 1992 as a small fabrication and assembly shop undertaking work for conventional mobile racks. Experience with storage-system users led the company to develop an integrated approach to storage planning and custom-built storage solutions. Its product range spans mobile racks, automated storage systems, and other allied storage solutions.

products.name: STOMAT
products.summary: An automated vertical carousel for high-density storage and retrieval of small parts and other listed materials.
products.concept: Storage shelves or trays are mounted on vertical chain loops driven by a geared brake motor and controlled by a PLC. The selected shelf is retrieved by its number using the shortest route. The system is enclosed in sheet-metal cladding and operates on the paternoster elevator principle.
products.whereToUse: Suitable for small-parts storage where the number of items is high.
benefits: The brochure states three-times savings in cost, time, and energy compared with a conventional system.
The brochure states 40% floor-space saving while making use of available height.
Automated retrieval reduces manual effort.
The geared-chain, electronically controlled system is described as low-noise.
The system can be operated manually in case of power failure.
Designed and manufactured around customer requirements.
features: Carriers are mounted closely on twin endless chains.
Shelves rotate in either direction in a vertical plane.
Material reaches the operating zone by the nearest path.
Torsion-free, self-supporting, powder-coated construction.
Work table is listed at 1 metre from the ground.
PLC control.
controller: A tray, bin, or component can be retrieved by its part number.
The PLC remembers the carrier position in case of power failure.
PC or control-computer connection through an RS 232 C serial port.
safety: Safety bars at the top and bottom of the operating window stop the system when pressed.
Manual operation is available in case of power failure.
trays: Storage shelves or material-storage trays mounted on vertical chain loops.
drives: Geared brake motor and twin endless chains.

facts.label: Comparison stated in brochure
facts.value: Three times cost, time, and energy saving

products.name: STOLIFT
products.type: Modular automated storage and retrieval system (shuttle)
products.summary: A PLC-controlled shuttle system that retrieves material carriers from selected storage locations and brings them to the operating window.
products.concept: A PLC-controlled platform moves special material carriers between the control station and a selected storage location. The operator enters a part number or location; the platform retrieves the tray from the designated rack and brings it to the operating window. The system is described as a modular automated storage and retrieval system using vertical-lift technology.
products.whereToUse: For mid-sized, mid-weight components or parts that need secure storage, fast retrieval, precise inventory control, and use of available height.
benefits: The brochure states 40% floor-space saving through use of available height.
The retriever locates and retrieves trays for fast access.
Enclosed racks protect stored material from theft, dust, mishandling, or damage.
The brochure describes reduced manpower through automation.
Inventory is retrieved by part number and quantity for precise control.
features: Flexible tray pitch, with fixed or optimized pitch selected for component height.
Machine height and capacity can be increased later.
The brochure describes lower power consumption than a vertical carousel.
Operation is described as free of vibration or jerks.
Material can be removed with the trays.
Further automation can transfer material through material-handling systems.
A barcode scanner can be connected externally.
Top access is available.
Automatic door and work-table load-carrying facility are listed.
controller: PLC-controlled platform retrieves material carriers by location or part number.
Sophisticated PLC control with an easy-to-operate interface.
safety: Stored material is held in completely enclosed racks.
applications: Mid-sized and mid-weight components or parts
Items requiring safe storage and precision inventory control
trays: Trays with modular sidewalls, partitions, and dividers

products.name: STORDER
products.type: Modular multi-axis storage and retrieval system
products.summary: A modular multi-axis system using X, Y, and Z movement, combining features of STOLIFT and STOPICK for compact storage of many SKUs.
products.concept: The storage system uses triple-axis X, Y, and Z movement. The brochure describes STORDER as combining advantages of STOLIFT and STOPICK in a limited space, for cases where one STOLIFT machine cannot accommodate many SKUs accessibly.
products.whereToUse: For manufacturing, stock-list, distribution, and warehouse operations that need to store many SKUs in limited space.
benefits: The brochure states that STORDER estimates access-opening requirements for each machine.
Reduces maintenance cost and the number of operations.
Provides precision and automation for storage and retrieval.
The number of picks per hour can be increased or matched to an individual STOLIFT machine.
features: Retrieving mechanism is described as lightweight and robust.
High-performance chain is described as quieter during operation.
Torsion-free structure with sturdy covers.
Positioning accuracy.
Vertical expansion by increasing the number of windows.

products.name: STOPICK
products.summary: A modular unit-load storage and retrieval system designed to use storage height and depth, with simultaneous X and Y movement.
products.concept: A storage-retrieval machine carries a load carrier on a mast and moves on rails in horizontal and vertical planes between two storage racks. An operating window is at the front of the aisle. The PLC-controlled carrier can be configured for the required height, depth, and speed.
products.whereToUse: Customizable for stores, warehouses, finished goods, and raw-material stores in manufacturing, pharmaceutical, automobile, engineering, and heavy-electrical industries.
benefits: One retrieval mechanism can serve a large storage area.
Integral storage uses available height and depth.
The brochure describes floor-space saving through full height use and an extremely narrow aisle.
The system is designed for one-person operation.
A completely enclosed system with a locking operating window protects stored material.
The modular rack and main carriage can be expanded.
features: Positive chain hoisting.
24 to 40 dual cycles per hour.
Simultaneous X and Y axis motion.
Busbar or trolley current supply.
On-board storage-retrieval machine control, off-board communication, and on-board diagnostics.
Double-arm lifting carriage guided on 8 rollers.
Load-extraction options include single-arm and double-arm telescopic forks and Retriever I (TM).
Core sensing, ergonomic workstation, and aisle-changer hardware for multiple aisles.
AC variable-frequency drive for hoisting and long travel.
Quadruple-chain hoisting, linear guideways, and optical load centering.
Optional man-on-board facility and PC or central-computer interface.
controller: PLC control with on-board SRM control.
Off-board communication and diagnostics for SRM faults.
safety: Full safety protocols through on-board sensors, as stated in the brochure.
Racking structure and storage-retrieval machine standards are listed in the brochure.
applications: Electronic parts, hardware, and small tools
Drums in chemical or process industries
Passenger-car storage and retrieval in parking lots
trays: Load carrier mounted on the storage-retrieval machine mast.
drives: AC variable-frequency drives for hoisting and long travel.

products.name: STOLONG
products.summary: An automated storage and retrieval system for bars, profiles, metal fittings, and sheet-metal systems in varied sizes and quantities.
products.concept: The system uses a random-cassette principle. Gantry cranes retrieve material and bring it to the operator; the material can then be carried to several workstations. Faster drives and a double-pulling device on the gantry crane are described as supporting material flow.
products.whereToUse: Steel and metal service centres, manufacturing, plastics, and aluminium industries.
benefits: Higher storage capacity and faster access with moderate investment.
The brochure describes faster drives and a double-pulling device for efficient material flow.
features: Gantry cranes operate at varied speeds.
Material can be supplied to several workstations.
System height is listed up to 25 metres.
The brochure lists commissioning cranes, buffer tables, chain conveyors, bundling devices, and truck-routing systems as options.
drives: Faster drives are offered as an option.
Double-pulling device on the gantry crane.

products.name: Compactors & Racking
products.type: Mobile rack storage system and other storage products
products.summary: Mobile shelving reduces the number of fixed aisles to a single access aisle; the brochure also lists other storage and racking products.
products.concept: Mobile shelving units move together to open an access aisle where needed. The brochure describes manual, crank, and electric drive options and a central locking system.
products.whereToUse: For offices, workshops, and household storage, including files, suspended folders, registers, card indexes, clothes, fittings, electrical and electronic articles, shoes, paints, medicines, and bins.
benefits: One movable access aisle serves the shelves; fixed aisles are only needed where simultaneous access is required.
A brochure example compares 30 fixed bays with mobile shelving and illustrates an 80% increase in linear shelf space.
The brochure describes suitability for varied storage applications.
features: Aisle-security service is available for special requirements or tailor-made products.
The central locking system protects the system against unauthorized access.
controller: Electric-drive control is designed to meet customer requirements.
applications: Files, suspended folders, registers, and card indexes
Clothes, fittings, electrical and electronic articles
drives: Manual block: the brochure lists up to 1,200 kg overall weight.
Crank drive: the brochure lists a 1:6 reduction ratio and up to 10 Tonne maximum base weight.
Electric drive: single-motor drive using a friction wheel running on the rail.
